items.summary: Maybe someday we'll find out what's going on with Sirius and Hadar, but it is not this day.
items.body: CD Projekt has a lot going on these days: The Witcher 4 , Cyberpunk 2 , a new Witcher 3 expansion and remaster , a remake of the original Witcher , probably some other stuff I've either forgotten or don't know about, and a couple of long-simmering mystery projects that are still only known by their codenames, Sirius and Hadar. You'd be forgiven for forgetting about them, given their low profile and drawn-out development times, but in today's H1 investors call , CD Projekt's vice president of investor relations Karolina Gnaś reassured everyone that they're still happening—just not anytime soon. Asked about Sirius, Gnaś mentioned the recent cuts to the development team , saying—as CD Projekt did when the layoffs happened—that the changes were made to meet "the current needs of the project." "Pre-production is ongoing, and at this stage we are focused on testing different solutions and ideas we develop," Gnaś said. "This project is very different from our other projects because it's focused on multiplayer. So there's a lot of learning and testing in this particular one." Sirius first came to light in 2021, when CD Projekt acquired The Molasses Flood , known for The Flame in the Flood…

items.body: The Blood of Dawnwalker is a punishing game. And not just because of the divisive time-as-a-resource-to-be-managed side of things (or the almost impossible to resist desire to shift 'the' around in the title) but because it will slay your PC in terms of performance. We've covered the fact that in order to hit any of the performance level system requirements you have to enable upscaling in Balanced mode , but it's also worth noting that those system requirements are a little generous, too. I've been testing Dawnwalker for the past week or so, with a few different setups, and in those forests of Carpathia you're going to either need some more beefy hardware to hit Rebel Wolves' proposed frame rate targets or compromise on those graphics settings. Which is where I'm coming in here, aiming to help you get the highest frame rate out of your rig without sacrificing the actual look of the game. And, actually The Blood of Dawnwalker does pretty well even down at the lower end of the graphics settings, still looking relatively crisp and with a detailed open world for you to explore to your vampyric heart's content. items.body: These are big days for The Witcher 3 : It's not only getting a full-on story expansion in 2027, a remaster of the base game is also coming later this month. Even better, anyone who owns the original Witcher 3 will get the remaster for free. That's pretty generous as these things go, but in an interview with The Game Business , CD Projekt co-CEO Michał Nowakowski said there was never any thought of doing it differently. "It was never a question we asked ourselves," Nowakowski said. "We were going deeper into the development of Songs of the Past with Fool's Theory, and we started chatting: 'Why don't we make the game more modern? Everything felt like it was developed 10 years ago.' Because it was developed more than 10 years ago. "We started chatting about what we could do to improve it. It started with small things and then it turned into this larger project, and we suddenly realized we had a remaster on our hands." items.summary: The Amnesia Fortnight Kickstarter blew past its goal in just two days, but getting a new Brutal Legend is going to be a whole different pile of money
items.body: One happy upside to Double Fine's newly-regained independence is the return of Amnesia Fortnight , the semi-regular in-house game jam in which everyone stops what they're doing and spends two weeks pitching and developing prototypes for new games. The 2026 edition of the event—seemingly the first since Microsoft acquired Double Fine in 2019—launched a Kickstarter campaign on August 31, and its $400,000 goal has already been surpassed. The Amnesia Fortnight crowdfunding campaign serves two purposes. It raises money for Double Fine, which is good, but it also grants power : Just like in a real democracy, people who are willing to spend money will get to sway the process in voting for which of the 26 game pitches actually get made, and the more you spend the more influence you have. At the $15 tier, for instance, your vote only counts for half, but at $30 you get a full vote—and if you go up to $60, your vote is doubled—a single vote cast counts for two! What a great system. items.title: Dwarf Fortress co-creator says his life as a millionaire is 'basically like reattaining what my parents could do with regular jobs'
items.summary: Tarn Adams lives in a house now. I bet that's nice.
items.body: Back in 2024, Dwarf Fortress surpassed 800,000 copies sold, more than enough to make co-creators Tarn and Zach Adams millionaires . At the time, they seemed to be taking a low-key approach to the whole mo' money thing, so when our intrepid interviewer Joshua Wolens caught up with Tarn at the recently-concluded Gamescom, he asked if, in the two years since then, he'd more fully adjusted to his moneybags lifestyle. "I guess, a bit, somewhat. I mean, I live in a house now. I have two cats and they love me. That's great," Adams said. But, he added, it wasn't so much a matter of adjusting to something new as just going back to what used to be. "I know what [having a house] is like because I grew up in one. It's basically like reattaining what my parents could do with regular jobs. It's not much different from that. "And I don't want to make light of financial security, right? I mean, yeah, that's great, and I wish it for everybody." items.title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance's new combat gimmick is putting some Devil May Cry stink on hitting dinosaurs with hammers
items.summary: Welcome back, Impact Crater.
items.body: Back in June, Capcom revealed Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance , a "massive," Iceborne-style expansion promising new and returning monsters, new regions to hunt in, and—of course—new combat options. In the announcement trailer, Capcom offered a brief glimpse at the Boost Bracer, an enigmatic new mechanic that seemed to augment hunter fighting styles with additional jolts of combustion-fueled power. Three months later, we're now getting our first real insight into how the Boost Bracer works and how we can expect it to alter the flow of hunting in Wilds. Earlier today, Capcom uploaded both a video overview of Boost Bracer mechanics and a great sword-focused boost action breakdown , with similar videos expected for each other weapon type. Having watched both, I feel safe in saying Capcom's borrowing some pages from one of its other flashy action franchises: With the Boost Bracer, Ascendance has more than a little Devil May Cry in the mix. items.summary: يامال توجه إلى العاصمة الفرنسية.. فما السبب؟
items.body: يامال توجه إلى العاصمة الفرنسية.. فما السبب؟ سجل لامين يامال، هدفين في 3 مباريات خاضها هذا الموسم مع برشلونة، ليؤكد اللاعب البالغ من العمر 19 عامًا، أنه سيكون من الأسماء التي يجب وضعها في الحسبان مرة أخرى خلال هذا الموسم. ويستعد يامال لخوض مواجهة فالنسيا، مع فريقه الكتالوني، الأحد المقبل، في الجولة الرابعة من عمر الدوري الإسباني، لكنه تمكن من الاستفادة من فترة راحة قصيرة من أجل السفر. وذكر موقع فوت ميركاتو ، أن يامال توجه إلى العاصمة الفرنسية، حيث أتيحت له فرصة الاستمتاع بأجواء باريس، كما أظهر عبر حساباته على مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي. وستكون هذه الوجهة، مألوفة أمام يامال مجددًا بعد بضعة أسابيع، إذ سيتوجه برشلونة إلى ملعب حديقة الأمراء، لمواجهة باريس سان جيرمان، يوم 20 أكتوبر/تشرين أول، ضمن منافسات دوري أبطال أوروبا. واستهل برشلونة، حملة الدفاع عن لقب الدوري الإسباني، بالفوز في أول 3 جولات، على حساب إلتشي وأتلتيك بيلباو ورايو فاليكانو. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة   View this post on Instagram

items.body: Earlier this year, shots were fired and an incendiary device was thrown at the house of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. In a recent interview with Time , he reflected on the past year: "It has been a painful personal experience. Clearly, people hate data centres—right now, at least. People are pretty negative on AI." Does that mean OpenAI is packing it in, and going home? Well, no. The AI infrastructure buildout is continuing in earnest, with OpenAI planning to invest another $50 million this year alone on collecting compute. Sachin Katti, the co-lead on OpenAI's compute strategy told Time that the company's earlier investments now appear "very prescient," going on to add, "We are still short of compute. Perhaps I'm the problem—maybe a decade of playing horror games pretty much non-stop has irrevocably altered my brain chemistry. Take Resident Evil Requiem , for example—that just doesn't make the cut for a horror game in my book. Apart from the first five minutes in the underground cells, there just wasn't anything that felt particularly scary. In fact, I don't believe that any horror game that gives me a gun can be scary, except for Amnesia: The Bunker—I genuinely thought that game was going to kill me. Again, I find myself thinking that there's something up with my nervous system, because even Hideki Kamiya, director of Resident Evil 2 , would disagree with me. Now, almost half a decade later, 30,000 games either enjoy the green stamp of being Steam Deck verified, or are at least considered 'playable.' That's a big jump from the 3,000 games either Verified or Playable back in May 2022 . 'Verified' means your game of choice should work great on the Steam Deck from first boot, whereas 'Playable' games require either some finagling or adjustments for the best experience. The reward for many of The Dark Ages team was to be instantly laid off , as Xbox cut 136 members of the studio's workforce. Now, it also appears that getting Revelations to the finish line was a punishing experience for those involved, at least according to former id Software producer Andrew Willis.
